tagline.en: A human image animation model built on Wan2.1-I2V — bring a reference image and a pose signal, get a driven video.
tagline.zh: 一个基于 Wan2.1-I2V 的人物图像动画模型——给它一张参考图与姿态信号，输出被驱动的视频。

en: UniAnimate-DiT is a human image animation model. It takes a reference image of a person and animates it, producing a video in which the subject moves according to a driving pose or motion signal.

It is built on the Wan2.1 image-to-video architecture, adapting that video backbone to the human-animation task. In WorldFoundry the route exposes controls for maximum frames, resolution, step count, and seed.
In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared pipeline — provide the reference image and driving signal, set your frame and resolution options, and it writes out an animated video.
zh: UniAnimate-DiT 是一个人物图像动画模型。它接收一张人物参考图并让其动起来，生成一段主体按驱动姿态或动作信号运动的视频。
它构建于 Wan2.1 图生视频架构之上，将该视频骨干适配到人物动画任务。在 WorldFoundry 中，该路径提供最大帧数、分辨率、步数与随机种子等控制项。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一 pipeline 运行它——提供参考图与驱动信号，设置帧数与分辨率选项，它就会输出一段动画视频。

whenToUse.en: When you want to animate a person from a single reference image driven by a pose or motion signal, and want control over frame count, resolution, steps, and seed.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一张人物参考图、由姿态或动作信号驱动生成人物动画，并希望控制帧数、分辨率、步数与随机种子时。

notFor.en: General text-to-video or non-human scenes — it is specialized for human image animation. Checkpoint and assets are loaded separately, so plan for the download.
notFor.zh: 不适合通用文生视频或非人物场景——它专注于人物图像动画。Checkpoint 与相关资产需单独加载，请预留下载时间。
